title: Atmospheric Soda Firing Workshop
host_org: Watershed Center for the Ceramic Arts
source_quote:
Atmospheric Soda Firing
Dates
October 15–18, 2026
Instructor
Matthew Dercole
Cost
Public — $450
summary: Matthew Dercole teaches a four-day soda firing workshop, October 15–18, covering glazing, firing a gas downdraft kiln, and unloading. Participants bring Cone 10 bisqueware; the $450 fee (or $75 for K–12 educators) includes firing, soda ash, wadding, glaze, and meals.
evidence_sentence: The workshop description covers soda firing from glazing through unloading the kiln in a gas downdraft firing.
evidence_quote: Dive into the world of atmospheric firing with teaching artist and Watershed's Studio Manager, Matthew Dercole. This multi-day workshop will cover everything you need to know to incorporate soda firing into your ceramics practice, from glazing to firing to unloading the kiln. Learn how soda firing can enhance your work through hands-on experience and discussions of glaze chemistry, firing techniques, and general need-to-knows of firing a gas downdraft kiln.
cost_text: Public — $450; K–12 Educators — $75 (includes meals, materials, & firing)
bring: Cone 10 bisqueware of different sizes (about 1.5 cubic feet per person), cotton clothing and closed toe shoes, respirator with OV cartridges, safety goggles and leather gloves, packing material
commitment: Thurs 10/15 9 AM–5 PM, Fri 10/16 9 AM–late evening, Sat 10/17 off, Sun 10/18 9 AM–12:30 PM
how_to_join: Register via the link on the workshop page
